To Ahmed,

written on the 19th of Nov

I love you so much, more than I thought I’d do.

I’ve never did these things: writing letters, calls, thinking abt someone the whole day, sharing my day. Never wanted to build a future with someone as much as I want with you, my sweet boy.

When I think about you I see my sweet, funny, gentle, caring and most handsome man, and you’re mine, and I’m keeping you. You’re stuck with me, baby.

I love you, your smile, the sound of your laugh, your sense of humor… damn, I love you so much.

Written letters can get lost…

here’s one you can’t escape.

I love you, from Anan ♥
